title: XCID exposes CRDT log internals, violates Hard Design Invariant 1
description: session.rs implements XCID and advertises it in CAPABILITIES. Hard Design Invariant 1 prohibits extensions that expose CRDT log internals. LogEntry returned by XCID contains hlc_timestamp, article_cid, operator_signature, and parent_cids. If trusted_peers is empty any connected peer can issue XCID queries.
